'''Anthony Alfien''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 4th at [[March 2001 Phoenix tournament (23 March)]] on 23 March 2001, according to Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1940">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01d1940/ viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 24 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-24-viper-is-almost-cool-phoenix-3-23-01d1940/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
